suggestion.title: Suragu: give Magma Slayer and Eruption Strike the kit's scaling
suggestion.rationale: Two Suragu damage jutsu are missing attribute scaling. Set them to the Highest/Highest scaling the rest of the kit uses.

Magma Slayer's Lava damage hit is missing its attribute scaling and lists the four fighting styles instead. Suragu is a style-neutral bloodline: its passive boosts are element-based and the kit's other damage jutsu, Infernal Stream, scales on the Highest stat and Highest attribute. This sets the hit to the same Highest/Highest scaling. Power, wound rider and every other field are unchanged.

Eruption Strike's Lava pierce hit is missing its attribute scaling and lists the four fighting styles instead. Suragu is a style-neutral bloodline: its passive boosts are element-based and the kit's other damage jutsu, Infernal Stream, scales on the Highest stat and Highest attribute. This sets the hit to the same Highest/Highest scaling. Power, afterburn rider and every other field are unchanged.
